subject: IEG kickoff - training that survives noisy labels
body:
Team,

Kicking off the IEG workstream. Our labeling platform produces labels of, let's be honest, mixed quality - and every consumer team pays for it in silent accuracy loss. Our open-source work on meta sample re-weighting gives us two tools: IEG (distilling effective supervision from severe label noise) and FSR (fast sample re-weighting without reward data). The claim worth productizing: with the right re-weighting, training stays usable even at extreme noise ratios.

Scope this window: reproduce IEG on CIFAR100 at 20/40/80% uniform noise with wrn28-10, evaluate FSR as the cheaper alternative, and produce a recommendation for a 'noise-robust training' option on the platform.

Milestones: IEG repro by end of May, FSR comparison by end of June, recommendation memo by 2026-07-13.

Tereza leads methodology, Bilal experiments, Chiara and Emeka infra. Bruno - resourcing note when ready.

Dmitri
